<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
A mixed issue was found for Anderson in `repent-and-believe.md`.

The note risks conflating repentance with the entrance condition for eternal life. Anderson distinguishes repentance from faith: repentance is internal resolve for both believers and unbelievers, while faith is the condition for eternal life. Repentance belongs to fellowship, not to the ingress requirement.

Mark 1:15 addresses Israel’s kingdom and gospel. The Free Grace hub should place repentance with fellowship whenever eternal life is in view. The repent-and-believe note needs correction so repentance does not function as a ticket into heaven. Phrases like “not a down payment on salvation” and “receive the kingdom as gift” are acceptable.

The phrase "this pair is how life begins" wrongly treats repentance and faith as joint conditions for eternal life. They may coincide during conversion, yet repentance is not the price of salvation. The repent-and-believe note will be included in the expound because it connects to discipleship and carries doctrinal weight. A comprehensive draft of free-grace.md is now being prepared.
</details></think>
